title: ZeroTick Akt 1
description: The official modpack for ZeroTick SMP!
body:
ZeroTick Client Pack is a lightweight, performance-focused Minecraft modpack **made for ZeroTick SMP and technical gameplay.** It includes all _essential client-side_ features needed for ZeroTick mechanics, while keeping FPS high and load times low.
The pack combines strong optimization mods with carefully selected _Quality-of-Life improvements,_ such as better HUD info, inventory management, and useful client tools for redstone and farming.
**No unnecessary extras,** no visual overkill — just a clean, fast and reliable client for players who want to focus on gameplay and automation.
Perfect for technical servers, SMPs, and anyone who wants smooth performance with smart QOL features.
